req.title: Basic-auth accepts correct credentials
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd> with HTTP 200 and an authenticated=true JSON body when the supplied Basic credentials match.

doc.reasoning: The requirement covers GET /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd> returning HTTP 200 with {authenticated: true, user: <user>} when correct Basic credentials are supplied. Key mutation targets: (1) the boolean check in check_basic_auth (auth and auth.username == user and auth.password == passwd), (2) the HTTP status codes 200 vs 401, (3) the JSON fields authenticated=True and user=user. Tests cover: positive path with correct credentials (EP), negative path with wrong password (NEG/DT), negative path with wrong username (NEG/DT), no credentials at all (NEG), case-sensitivity boundary for credentials (BVA), and exact JSON body field validation to catch boolean/string mutations.

tests.name: test_basic_auth_correct_credentials_returns_200_and_authenticated_true
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/myuser/mypasswd with correct Basic auth header matching path params
tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

def test_basic_auth_correct_credentials_returns_200_and_authenticated_true():
    client = app.test_client()
    creds = base64.b64encode(b'myuser:mypasswd').decode('ascii')
    r = client.get(
        '/basic-auth/myuser/mypasswd',
        headers={'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'}
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data['authenticated'] == True
    assert data['user'] == 'myuser'

test_basic_auth_correct_credentials_returns_200_and_authenticated_true()

tests.name: test_basic_auth_case_sensitive_password_boundary
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/user/Secret with Basic auth using 'secret' (lowercase) instead of 'Secret'
expected: HTTP status code is exactly 401 (case-sensitive mismatch)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-018: credentials must match exactly (case-sensitive boundary)
tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

def test_basic_auth_case_sensitive_password_boundary():
    client = app.test_client()
    # Path expects 'Secret', we send 'secret' — must be rejected
    creds = base64.b64encode(b'user:secret').decode('ascii')
    r = client.get(
        '/basic-auth/user/Secret',
        headers={'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'}
    )
    assert r.status_code == 401
    # Now send correct case — must be accepted
    creds_correct = base64.b64encode(b'user:Secret').decode('ascii')
    r2 = client.get(
        '/basic-auth/user/Secret',
        headers={'Authorization': f'Basic {creds_correct}'}
    )
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    data = r2.get_json()
    assert data['authenticated'] == True
    assert data['user'] == 'user'

test_basic_auth_case_sensitive_password_boundary()

tests.name: test_basic_auth_user_field_matches_path_param_not_header
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/alice/wonderland with correct Basic auth for alice:wonderland
Verify the returned user field equals the path param 'alice', not some other value
expected: JSON body authenticated is exactly True (boolean, not string)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-018: body {authenticated: true, user: <user>} — user field must reflect path param
tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

def test_basic_auth_user_field_matches_path_param_not_header():
    client = app.test_client()
    creds = base64.b64encode(b'alice:wonderland').decode('ascii')
    r = client.get(
        '/basic-auth/alice/wonderland',
        headers={'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'}
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data['authenticated'] is True
    assert data['user'] == 'alice'
    assert data['user'] != 'wonderland'
    assert len(data) == 2

test_basic_auth_user_field_matches_path_param_not_header()

import base64
from httpbin.core import app

def test_basic_auth_authenticated_field_is_boolean_true_not_truthy_string():
    client = app.test_client()
    creds = base64.b64encode(b'bob:builder').decode('ascii')
    r = client.get(
        '/basic-auth/bob/builder',
        headers={'Authorization': f'Basic {creds}'}
    )
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data['authenticated'] is True
    assert data['authenticated'] != 'true'
    assert data['authenticated'] != 1
    assert data['user'] == 'bob'
